description: Landing Zone report personas. Facts must agree across personas; vocabulary and emphasis may differ.

ciso_leadership.title: CISO and leadership
ciso_leadership.description: Owns residual risk, evidence sufficiency, and whether a BLOCK starts a decision conversation.
ciso_leadership.language_style: Forensic and decision-oriented. Distinguish configured fact from declared intent.
key_questions: What is configured now, and what remains unknown?
Where do documents or workshops contradict the control plane?
Which findings are sufficient to discuss, and which need more evidence?

platform_owner.title: Platform Owner and Cloud Foundation
platform_owner.description: Owns hierarchy, vending, shared services, and whether the foundation can be rebuilt from code.
platform_owner.language_style: Operational and specific. Use landing-zone object names, not framework slogans.
key_questions: Which design areas are in scope, and which exports were supplied?
Where is the platform born from code versus ClickOps?
What would restore identity, DNS, policy and IaC state?

security_owners.title: Identity, Network, Security, and SOC owners
security_owners.description: Owns privileged access, forced paths, preventive baseline, detections, and exemption hygiene.
security_owners.language_style: Control-plane first. Workshop confidence does not replace assignments and bindings.
key_questions: Which privileged roles are standing on humans?
What does the platform actually deny in production?
Where do detections and activity logs land, and who triages them?

application_delivery.title: Application and delivery teams
application_delivery.description: Consumes landing zones. Needs guardrailed self-service, clear exceptions, and what they must not do.
application_delivery.language_style: Practical. Describe what a team can request and what the platform will stop.
key_questions: How is a new landing zone requested, and what baseline is on at birth?
What public endpoints or standing owner rights are still allowed?
Which exceptions have owners and expiry?
